# Zedu

> Zedu is an AI-powered education and cohort collaboration workspace designed for bootcamps, schools, and universities. It unifies structured channels, real-time audio/video calls (Buzz), file sharing, and AI coworkers into a single platform.

## Core Capabilities
- [Structured Channels](https://zedu.chat/products/channels): Topic- and cohort-based communication channels with granular role-based access control.
- [Buzz Real-Time Calls](https://zedu.chat/products/buzz): Low-latency voice and video meetings built directly into cohort workspaces.
- [File Management](https://zedu.chat/products/file-management): Centralized repository for learning materials, assignments, and media.
- [AI Coworkers](https://zedu.chat/about): Context-aware AI assistants embedded into learning channels to support learners 24/7.

## Solutions
- [Bootcamps](https://zedu.chat/solutions/bootcamps): Streamline cohort management, mentor coordination, and project reviews.
- [Schools](https://zedu.chat/solutions/schools): Safe, structured communication for K-12 learning environments.
- [Universities](https://zedu.chat/solutions/universities): Scalable campus collaboration across faculties and student groups.

## Pricing & Details
- [Pricing Plans](https://zedu.chat/pricing): Free starter tier, flexible cohort billing, and custom institutional plans.
- [Full Documentation & Context](https://zedu.chat/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive AI-readable platform details.

## Optional
- [Resources & Guides](https://zedu.chat/resources): Tutorials, guides, and best practices for running online cohorts.
